capabilities: Render checkbox skills as branch trees and a cross-branch constellation map
Define prerequisites with all (A & B) or any (A | B) requirements
Change skill status from a pinned card and update the note checkbox
List what is learning and newly unlocked across all branches
Save the current map or tree as a PNG image
disambiguation: Not a gamification tracker: there is no XP, levels or scores, only a map of checkbox skills, their requirements and statuses.
problem: Obsidian shows skill checklists as flat lists with no view of prerequisites, current status or what becomes available next.
summary: Turns checkbox lists in notes into RPG-style skill trees and constellations with prerequisites, statuses and next-unlocked skills, no XP or levels.
